tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /ahosamudranāmabhaṭ+ṭārakamahāgururat+nadhādzabimok+ṣabiharatisma// ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho blo gros rgya mtshos yongs bzung ste/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i spyod pa rgya mtsho brtson pa rgya mtshos legs bsgrub pas/ /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa rgya mtsho lag len rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /skal ldan rgya mtsho'i dad pa rgya mtshor gdams pa rgya mtshos gtams mdzad rgyal/ /skyon med yon tan kun gyi mdzod mnga' khyod kyi rnam thar ma lus pa/ /grangs med lce yis bskal par brjod kyang bas par mi 'gyur de lta na'ang / /bslu med ngag gis thun mong grags pa tsam zhig 'dir ni brjod pa la/ /zol med dad pa'i yid ldan don gnyer tshogs rnams dga' bas nyan par gyis/ /rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse gcig tu bsdus nas snyigs ma'i dus su gangs ri'i khrod 'dir mi'i gzugs su sprul te/ 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar chu rgyun zhes bya ba tshigs su bcad pa bdun cu pa zhig sngar rnam par spel ba las/ slar yang de nyid kyi don rnam par 'grel pa cig gyis shig ces yul mchog la dad pa dang ldan pa dag gis bskul ba'i phyir na ngo mtshar rgya mtsho 'di 'bri ba la skyon med do/ /'di la gsum ste/ rtsom pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don/ brtsam par bya ba gzhung gi don/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la mtshan gyi don/ mchod par brjod pa/ bshad pa dam bca' ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar chu rgyun zhes bya ba zhes pa ste/

rje btsun dam pa'i yon tan ma dros pa'i mtsho las byung zhing / mthong ba dang thos pa dag gis ngo mtshar gyi dpal bskyed la/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i phyir na de skad ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ lam ston pa po sangs rgyas la mchod par brjod pa/ dngos grub ster ba po bla ma nyid la mchod par brjod pa dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkon mchog mkhyen pa'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ 'di'i mtshan gyi don mkhyen brtse nus pa gsum dang sbyar nas/ de nyid kyang rigs gsum gyi rgyal ba gsum dang mtshungs par ston pa'o/ /nas zhes pa ni lhag ma 'dren pa'i tshig go /gsum pa ni/ skyes chen dam pa'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ skyes bu chen po 'di nyid nges pa'i don du 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su phyi dang nang gi mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul gyis mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ slar yang 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med pa na/ sprul pa dpag du med pas sems can gyi don mdzad par nges pa'i phyir na rnam par thar pa ma lus pa ni sus kyang brjod par mi nus te/ tshad gzung du med pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i cha shas zhing 'dir skal ba mnyam pa'i gdul bya rnams la thun mong du snang ba rgya mtsho lta bu las dad pa'i blo gros kyi snyim pas bcus te/ bdag nyid kyang dam pa 'di lta bu las gdams pa 'di lta bu thob bo snyam du yid tshim pa dang / gzhan dag la yang dad pa'i chu rgyun ma skyes pa skyed pa dang / skyes pa spel ba'i phyir du rang nyid kyis mthong ba dang / yid ches pa las thos pa dang / yang dag pa'i gtan tshigs las nges pa rnyed pa rnams brjod par bya'o zhes pa'i don to/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ yon tan rtogs pa'i ched du rnam thar brjod pa/ bsod nams spel ba'i ched du rgyun bshags bya ba/

'bras bu 'grub pa'i ched du smon lam gdab pa'o/ /dang po la brgyad de/ rigs khyad par can du 'khrungs pa'i tshul/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas bskul ba'i tshul/ bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i tshul/ thos bsam gyis rgyud sbyangs pa'i tshul/ bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ bla ma lha yis rjes su bzung ba'i tshul/ 'bras bus bstan pa la bya ba byas pa'i tshul/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar gzhan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya chen smon lam zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ 'gro ba mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon du gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam gyis sngon bsags pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi chu gter bsrubs pa las/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i bstan par gser gyi ri bos bskor ba'i gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dal 'byor gyi lhun po brnyes te/ de yang dbus gtsang ru bzhir grags pa'i g.yas ru byang gi cha 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i skyes chen du ma byon pa'i mus kyi lung pa'i stod/ rta mo gling skya zhes bya bar/ yab dkon mchog bzang po lo so bzhi lon pa'i dus su/ yum nam mkha' skyong las/ sa pho 'brug gi lo la rje 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i mtshan dkon mchog dar zhes bya'o/ /de yang 'di'i rigs zhang / rus pa ldong yin la/ yab mes zhang 'od ldan des mus su byon/ de'i sras po zhang g.yung nge bcu gcig zhal la thugs dam du mdzad pas lo gya drug thub/ de'i sras dkon mchog bzang po ste/ nam mkha' blo gros pa la rab byung zhus pa'i mtshan dkon mchog dpal/ de nas jo nang pa nam chos pa la don zhags dang / sbyor drug zhus/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa las khrid zab mo 'ga' zhig zhus te/ don zhags kyi gzungs dang yi ge drug pa la thugs dam mdzad pa zhig ste/ des na rje 'di nyid ni skyes bu dam pa'i rigs su 'khrungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhon nu nyid nas zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/

rje 'di nyid chung ngu'i dus nas phyi rol gyi dngos po'i 'gyur ba tsam la brten nas kyang mi rtag pa'i blo skyes te/ 'jig rten thams cad la zhen pa log pa dang / phyogs mtha' med du mi dang / ba glang dang / ri dwags sogs rab tu mang po yod pa la dpag nas 'khor ba mtha' med du rtogs/ nges 'byung gi blo drag po skyes pa dang / dgung lo gnyis gsum tsam na yab yum gyi rum du gzims pa'i dus su snang ba bden med du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes pa dang / rtsed mo rtse ba'i dus su yang rdo ba dang tsha khang gi lha la sogs pa che ba rnams la chung ba rnams btud nas btsun pa gyis/ dbang bskur zhus zhes bya ba la sogs pa las tha mal gyi rtsed mo mi mdzad pa dang / brag phug sogs su slebs pa'i tshe sgom byed pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa sogs rnam pa thams cad du dge ba bsgrub par bzhed pa'i ngang tshul can yin par grag go /de nas dgung lo dgu tshun chad du bla ma gu ru pa zhes bya ba dang / bla ma mkha' 'gro ba zhes bya ba'i bud med cig dang / bla ma nam mkha' blo gros pa rnams la chos cung zad gsan no/ /gsum pa ni/ bstan la 'jug tshe zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su/ mkhan po rgyal sras thogs pa med pa'i dngos slob dbang 'od bzang po/ slob dpon dpal 'od pa las dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos te mkhan po las/ kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang / theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zin bris ma/ 'gro mgon dpal ye bas mdzad pa'i rgyal sras pa'i rnam thar gyi lung rnams gsan no/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ 'dren pa gzhan las ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul/ 'dren pa mchog las ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad bdun te/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni skye ba thams cad du yang dag pa'i lam la goms pa'i stobs kyis/ gzhon nu'i dus nyid nas thos pa rgya mtsho'i gling du 'jug par mdzad do/

/de yang 'di skad thos te/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa na/ mus kyi chos sde gle lung zhes bya bar/ chen po byang seng ba sku mched kyi drung du byon te/ phar phyin dang spyod 'jug la thugs spyod mdzad/ bar skabs su bla ma nam mkha' chos bzang pa la dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / 'jigs byed kyi dbang gsan cing / byang seng ba las phar phyin bu ṭīka gi skabs dang po'i lung dang / zhing mo che ba'i blo sbyong yang gsan te/ bco brgyad pa na chos sde de nyid du bshad pa dang / de'i dga' ston rgya chen po mdzad do/ /nyi shu pa na mus kyi gnas gsar zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa'i zhabs drung du byon te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gcod kyi khrid zhus nas/ spyir gcod khrid la thun drug tu byed pa yin na yang / thun gyi bye brag med par nyin mtshan khor yug tu brtson pa drag pos bsgom pas thugs dam gyi gzigs snang mang po dang / byams pa dang snying rje tshad med pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/ khyad par du bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ yum gyi skye ba phyi ma gang yin bstan du gsol zhes gsol ba drag tu btab nas gzigs pas/ 'di dang 'di yin zhes pa'i mtshan ma lan gnyis su byung ba sogs kyi nyams rtogs khyad par can mang du 'khrungs so/ /de nas de'i chos skor la/ skye med do pa nas brgyud pa'i gcod kyi khrid/ ma gcig sogs kyi lo rgyus/ grwa pa hag gi lo rgyus/ rgya nag gcer bu'i bka' brgyud/ sma ra ser po'i bka' brgyud/ bka' tshoms kyi gzhung / bka' tshoms kyi gzhung lan so lnga pa/ ār+ya de ba'i tshigs bcad che chung gnyis 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang / ngo sprod lta ba'i skor/ nyams len spyod pa'i skor/ bogs 'don gegs sel gyi skor/ lam rim pa bcu gsum la sogs pa ma gcig gi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa gsan no/

/nyer gcig pa la ngam rings kyi chos sde chen por slob dpon chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dang / de'i slob chung dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas blo gros pa dpon slob kyi drung du bsnyen te/ gtso bor phar tshad la thugs sbyongs/ sangs rgyas blo gros pa las jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa'i lung rnams gsan te/ nyer gsum pa la chos grwa de nyid du grwa skor yang mdzad do/ /nyer bzhi pa la bzang ldan gyi mkhas pa chen po thugs rje dpal ba la stod lhor byon pa'i chag phyir byon/ lo gcig tsam bzhugs nas lung rigs legs par sbyangs nas dngos stobs rigs pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur te/ pha rol gyi rgol ba gang la yang mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob par gyur to/ /nyer lnga pa la 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i dbang po g.yag sprug sangs rgyas dpal la stod lhor phebs pa dang mjal te/ phar phyin gyi bshad pa tshar phyed dang gnyis/ mdo sdud pa/ mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi lung / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed rnams gsan te/ de nyid kyi lor gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar grwa skor mdzad de bshad pa dang ston pa la kun gyis mthun snang du grub par gyur to/ /nyer drug pa la mdog gi tsha sna zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du/ gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa dang mjal te 'chag phyir byon/ lung rigs la thugs sbyangs nas/ nyer bdun pa la gnas gsar du chos rje nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa la 'jal du byon pas/ sngar gcod khrid zhus pa'i dus kyi dge sbyor gyi brtson pa drag po dang / nyams rtogs kyi 'khrungs lugs khyad par can rnams la thugs dgyes pa'i stobs kyis da ni gu cig zhus nas dge sbyor la dril ba cig 'thad ces pa'i zhal da gnang ba la/ 'dul mngon dang dbu ma rtsa 'jug sogs pu sti 'ga' yar zhig la grwa skor byas nas/ de nas dge sbyor la dril ba zhu zhes zhus pas/

chos kyi don go na grwa skor ma byas kyang nyes pa med/ don ma go na grwa skor byas kyang dgos pa med pas cis kyang dge sbyor la dril ba drag ces gsung / 'o na de ltar byed pa zhu zhus nas/ thog mar ni gu chos drug gi khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ sems 'chi med rnams kyi khrid zhus nas/ chos drug rdo rje'i tshig rkang / tshig gsal them yig mus chen pas mdzad pa'i khrid yig sgyu ma lam rim rtsa 'grel sgyu ma gtan la dbab pa/ sgyu lus 'dzin pa rang grol/ lam dri ma med pa la sogs pa'i ni gu'i chos skor rdzogs par zhus/ yang nā ro chos drug gi khrid zhus nas nā ro'i khrid yig thabs lam tshigs bcad ma la sogs pa nā ro chos drug gi chos skor rdzogs par gsan/ yang phyag rgya chen po snying po don gyi khrid yig la sogs pa phyag rgya chen po'i chos skor rnams dang / yang dgon pa'i ri chos yon tan kun 'byung la sogs pa ri chos kyi skor rnams dang / blo sbyong rtse mo gnyis pa la sogs pa blo sbyong gi skor 'ga' zhig dang / zhi byed skam lugs kyi khrid zhus nas zhi byed bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus che chung gnyis la sogs pa'i zhi byed kyi skor yongs su rdzogs pa gsan te/ de dag kyang ming rkyang tsam du ma lus par so so'i nyams rtogs rnams rgyud la skyes skyes kyi bar du brtson pa drag pos bsgoms pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas khyod la nyams rtogs 'di dang 'di 'dra byung 'dug go zhes ngo sprod kyang mdzad/ gzhan yang dbang gi skor la/ tshe dpag med/ kun rig 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor/ bde mchog dril bu pa rnams kyi dbang gsan no/ /nyer brgyad pa la slar yang chos rje rgyal mchog pa'i chag phyir byon te/ so gcig pa'i bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral ba med par bsten/ spyod lam gyi kyang mnyes par byas te/ phar phyin/ tshad ma/ dbu ma/ mngon pa kun las btus/

'dul ba mdo rtsa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung rnams legs par sbyangs par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe kun btus kyi ṭīka dang / mdzod chen gyi ṭīka shog bu bcu bzhi tsam chos thun re la gsungs pa rnams rje 'di kho nas bskyor ba dang / dbu ma'i spyi don dgag sgrub dang / lung rab tu mang po dang bcas pa rnams kyang / rje 'di kho nas bzung nus pas/ chos rje rgyal mchog pas shes rab che ba'i mtshan gzhi gcig la phyogs kun tu bsgrags par mdzad do/ /khyad par du sum cu pa la dngul chu'i chos rdzong du/ bla ma gser gling pa nas brgyud pa'i theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong nyams khrid du zhus nas bsgoms pas/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis kyi rtogs pa skyes pa'i tshul ni 'og tu brjod par bya'o/ /so gcig pa sa pho khyi lo la snyigs dus kyi thub dbang gnyis pa rong ston chos rje bzang ldan du bzhugs pa'i drung du byon te/ phar phyin gyi skabs bzhi pa dang / rnam 'grel gyi gzhan don le'u'i bshad pa dang / rje de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma'i stong thun rnams gsan no/ /de'i ston rje de nyid dang / sa bzang na chos rje rgyal mchog pa bzhugs pa gnyis kyi/ chos rje nam mkha' ba'i drung du gdams ngag zab mo zhu ba'i snyan zhus la btang ste/ bla ma'i drung du zhus nas/ dam pa de nyid gnas gsar du gdan drangs/ rong ston chos rje zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs te/ ni gu dang bde mchog snyan brgyud sogs gdams ngag du ma gsan nas la stod lho la thegs/ chos rje rgyal mchog pa de'i dgun/ phag lo'i dpyid dbyar rnams la de nyid du bzhugs nas/ bo dong du gdan drangs pa'i chag phyi rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad/ slar gnas gsar du byon te ni gu la sogs pa'i khrid rnams bskyar ma zhus/ chos 'phro rnams phal cher rdzogs nas/ byi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu drug la chos rje nam mkha' ba bde bar gshegs pa'i gsol 'debs/

gshegs rdzongs/ gdung rus sāts+tsha btab pa/ phyi rten tshun chad grub ste thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas sngar ngam rings su mkhan chen sangs blo bas grwa tshang gi bshad nyan dgos gsungs pa bzlog kyang / de'i gleng bslangs byung gi dogs nas dbyar dang ston gnyis phyi ba khung sogs kyi lung stong du gcig pur bzhugs nas thugs dam mdzad/ dgun rdzing lung du bzhugs pas/ glang lo'i dpyid mkhan chen sangs blo bas cis kyang grwa tshang gi bshad nyan gyis/ mi kun khyod bsten ma shes zhes nga la 'thab tu 'ong bar 'dug gsungs pa la/ 'dod bzhed med pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus nas/ glang lo'i mjug tu lha sar byon/ stag lo'i cho 'phrul chen po la phyag dang bskor ba la sogs bsags sbyangs kyi rnal 'byor mdzad/ de nas nyang stod du chos rje rgyal mchog pa bzhugs pa'i drung du byon te/ mkhan po gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i bshes gnyen gangs can kun dga' dpal/ las kyi slob dpon don rin pa/ gsang ste ston pa chos rje rgyal tshab pa/ chos rje rgyal mchog pa la sogs pa dad pa'i dge 'dun nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi dbus su so lnga pa chu pho stag gi lo a mi yol du bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /de nas bo dong bar chos rje rgyal mchog pa'i phyag phyi mdzad nas/ mus su byon te/ so drug pa yos lo la mus su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ shog bu tshal du bla ma nam chos pa bde bar gshegs pa'i nub mor/ rje 'di'i mnal lam du/ bla ma nam chos pa bde ba can du gshegs/ khyod kyang da nas lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis na bde ba can du 'gro ba yod ces zer ba cig byung gsung ngo / /de'i ston chos rje rgyal mchog pa chu 'dus su bzhugs pas/ bshad nyan la shog gsungs pa'i pho nya phyag rtags dang bcas pa phebs/ bshad nyan mi byed kyang / de'i rgyu mtshan dang / sa skyar bka' lung zhu ru 'gro ba'i zhal da zhu ba la de ma thag byon pas/

chos rje dges nas/ sde de'i rigs bzang ba dang / nor phyug pa'i grwa pa sprod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi zang zing mang po 'ong ba'i zhal da gnang gin 'dug kyang / thugs la 'phrod pa tsam ma byung bar/ sngar ngam rings su slob dpon sangs blo ba la rigs bzang ba lha'i dbang po brgya byin/ nor phyug pa rnam thos kyi bu byung kyang 'dod pa med ces pa'i zhu phod phul ba de thugs la mnga' bas/ 'di lta bu'i zhal da gnang bas sgo med ces zhus te/ zhu ba dka' se ba zhig la grub bo/ /de dag gi skabs su yongs 'dzin gzhan las dam pa'i chos ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul ni/ byang seng ba'i gcung po mkhan chen bstan bzang pa la ba ri ba'i bskang bzlog gsan/ byang seng ba'i slob chung bkra shis rgyal ba la 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum gsan/ mkhan chen bstan rgyal ba la bu ston chos 'byung dang / don zhags lha lnga'i dbang la sogs pa gsan/ bla ma kun blo ba la spyod 'jug dang 'dul ba lung la sogs pa gsan/ gangs pa kun dga' bzang po pa la sum pa lo tsā ba'i snyan brgyud gsan/ spos khang ba rinargyal ba la ched du brjod pa'i tshoms gsan/ gnas rnying pa rin rgyal ba la zhi byed kyi skor pu sti drug tsam gsan/ bdag chen gzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan pa la tshad ma'i thun tshags gsan/ mi nyag jo gdan dpal bzang ba la chos cung zad dang / mnga' ris pa bha drwa shrī la phyag drug pa'i skor kha cig dang / jo nang du sgrub pa mo dbus ma la rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas gsan/ hor bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan la grub thob brgyad cu'i bstod pa dang / lam 'bras pa blo bzang ba la lam zab dang bla ma bka' bzhi pa dpal ldan seng ge la sa sde'i pu sti bzhi tsam dang / byang chen du bya bral ba bsod blo ba la ma ṇi'i lung rnams gsan/ theg chen chos rje'i drung du bde mchog lo hi pa'i dbang / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed gsan/ bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab la 'jug pa'i bshad pa dang /

rten 'brel snying po'i khrid rnams gsan/ mdog glo mkhan po yon tan dpal mgon pa la 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ rgya cher 'grel 'od ldan la sogs pa gsan/ gtsang gzhung pa slob dpon tshul bzang ba la dpe chos rin spungs dang / lha sa gru khung pa slob dpon sangs rgyas 'phel ba la phar phyin g.yag ṭīka chen mo'i lung dang bshad pa gsan/ shar pa slob dpon kun legs pa la gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang dang / mkhyen rab dbang phyugs grags pa dpal bzang po la mtshan brjod kyi lung gsan/ bla ma phyi ma drug po 'di las 'dren pa mchog las gsan pa'i rjes su gsan pa yin na'ang / sa bcad kyi tshoms mi 'khrugs par bya ba'i phyir du 'dir phyogs gcig tu bris so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gdams pa thob pa'i rgyu/ gdams pa gsan pa'i tshul/ gsang chen rgyud sde'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rgya mtsho lta bu bsten kyang / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzang bzhin du slar yang gdams pa phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshol ba la ngoms pa med par mdzad do/ /de yang 'di skad thos te/ chos rje nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa de bde mchog lo nag dril gsum la thugs dam gyi gtso bor mdzad cing / bsngags pa yang che ba dang / mkhan chen sangs blo bas da bshad nyan mi mdzad na/ sngags kyi grwa sa cig tu sngags phyogs kyi slob gnyer rgya che rab cig mdzod gsungs pa la brten nas/ rdo rje theg pa'i bka' lung rgya chen po gsan par bzhed de/ sngar nyang stod du chos rje rgyal tshab pa la chag phyir 'gro ba'i snyan zhus phul na yang stabs shig gis ma thon/ de nas chos rje rgyal mchog pa'i chag phyir bo dong du phebs pa'i tshe/ shangs pa kun mkhyen pa'i drung du 'byon par bzhed de/ chos rje la zhus pas de 'thad gsungs nas/ rin spungs pa'i gser yig pa cig la sbrag yar mdzad pa yin na'ang /

de'i nangs par rang du 'byon ma bzhed par de nyid du bzhugs so/ /de rjes yun mi ring ba zhig nas/ nyag re grags pa skam po zer ba de/ chos rje rgyal mchog pa'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs zhu ru byung ba la/ spyir sa skya'i lo rgyus dang / bye brag tu bla ma kun dga' bzang po de yon tan che zhing / sgal tshigs bzang ba cig yin par grags pa ci 'dra yin dris pas/ khong na re/ spyir gsung rab spyi la mkhas/ khyad par bde dgyes la sogs pa sa skya pa'i chos skor la shin tu mkhas shing / sgal tshigs bzang zer ba yang sde dpon sogs la bsten phyogs mi mdzad pa ma gtogs/ grwa pa la shin tu brtse bas nyam chung gi bla ma yang dag pa cig yod zer ba gsan ma thag tu/ rtag tu ngus chos 'phags kyi gtam thos pa'am/ se ston kun rig gis/ mu gu lung gi thad kyi sprin dkar po mthong ba ltar/ thar pa'i lam ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin par nges shes gting nas 'khrungs te/ de'i zhabs drung du bsnyen nas bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs par zhus te/ g.yeng ba che chung gang gi yang dbang du ma song bar nyams len la dril ba cig bya dgos so snyam pa'i go cha dang rtag tu ma bral bar mdzad do/ /de'i stobs kyis/ yos lo'i mjug tu chu 'dus nas tshur res sa skyar byon/ shāka bzang sku 'bum na drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo rje btsun kun dga' bzang po bzhugs pa'i drung du/ mkhan chen shāka bzang ba brgyud de/ bdag la lo nag dril gsum gyi chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa cig sos ka tshun la rdzogs par gnang dgos zhus pas/ da lta mtshams dam pa cig la yod/ 'di tsho la lta rtog gyis gsungs nas bde mchog gi dpe cha 'ga' zhig gnang byung ste/ de'i ngang la zla ba gnyis tsam song nas/ so bdun pa shing pho 'brug gi lo shar ba'i tshe/ mkhas grub gzhon nu seng ge ba la zhu ba bskur te/

de ma thag tu mjal nas/ bla ma la mi phyed pa'i dad pa skyes shing / bla mas kyang thugs dges pa'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bla ma mchog las zhes sogs tshigs bcad drug ste/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni yongs 'dzin mchog las gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu thos shing / yon tan gyi mdzod du gyur pa ni chos nyid do/ /de'ang 'di skad thos te/ chos rje bzang po'i zhabs kyi drung du mjal ma thag nas brtsams te/ 'brug lo'i ston tshun chad la bde dgyes gsang gsum gyi smin byed kyi dbang / bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag rgyud kyi bshad pa dang bcas pa gsan cing / de nas rdo rje phreng ba/ kṛ ya sa muts+tsha dang bcas pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bka' drin dpag tu med pa nos pa mdzad do/ /me pho rta'i lo'i nang du/ chos rje bzang po'i zhabs bar chad kyi mtshan ma bsal ba'i ched du/ sku mtshams la bzhugs nas/ sku mtshams grol ba'i zhag gcig gi gong du/ rje 'di nyid dang / mnga' ris pa bla ma dkon mchog 'od zer gnyis sku mdun du bos nas/ spyir thugs dam gyi gzigs snang dang / bar chad sel tshul sogs mang du gsungs te/ da lan skyon du song na yang gzhan sems la 'phreng ba cig kyang med/ bya spyod gnyis kyi bstan pa 'di 'dod pa bzhin sos ma thub pa 'di dang / khyed rang gi phan thogs mi thogs gang yin kyang / khyod slob dpon dkon rgyal la lam 'bras tshang ma zhig ma 'phrod pa 'di 'phreng bar 'dug ces gsung ngo / /de la rje 'di nyid thugs zhed pa cig kyang byung zhing / bla ma thugs dgongs gang la gtad kyang da lam 'bras shig zhus nas dge sbyor gyi mthil de la byed dgos pa 'dug snyam pa 'khrungs so/ /de nas chos rje'i drung nas bdag mus su phyin nas/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dge sbyor cig byed pa lags zhus pas/ da dung nged la gsung ngag lam 'bras yod pas de nyon cig gsungs pa la/ lam 'bras zhu ba la 'bul ba mang po dang /

dka' spyad mang po dgos pa'i lo rgyus 'dug pas/ bdag la de lta bu'i nus pa med lags zhugs pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ sngon gyi dus na bstan pa yar sos dus su song bas/ gdul bya rnams chos la don gnyer dang / chos phyogs su dka' spyad dang / longs spyod gtong phod che bas gdul bya'i rgyud la rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs pa'i ched/ sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyis longs spyod mang po 'bul bzhes mdzad pa yin/ deng sang bstan pa 'grib nas gsung ngag la sogs pa'i bka' chad la khad du song 'dug pas/ gdul bya snod ldan byung na gsung ngag dang dbang bskur la sogs pa brdal gtod lta bu byas nas kyang / bstan pa'i rgyun la phan du re byed dgos pa'i dus su song 'dug pa zhes gsungs so/ /'di ni da lta gsung ngag rin po che la sogs pa'i bka' srol rnams bzung nas 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs mdzad pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs pa yin par nges so/ /de nas rta lo'i dbyar gsung ngag rin po che gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes te/ ston mus su phebs nas/ lug lo la mus su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma nam blo bas spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa dang / bye brag tu phyogs 'di'i dge 'dun rnams dang / bya nya/ ri dwags rnams kyi mgon skyabs mdzad dgos zhus nas dgon pa yang phul te/ khong rang dpon slob rnams kyis/ kye rdor dang kun rig la sogs pa'i bka' mang du zhus nas/ de dag gi lag len gyi srol yang 'dzugs par mdzad do/ /de'i ston chos rje bzang po'i zhabs mnga' ris su dpon po a me dpal gyis gdan drangs pa'i rjes su/ gsang sngags dbon po gzhon nu bzang po sogs grogs mched bdun/ chos rje'i bka' zhal dang bcas te/ rje 'di nyid gdan 'dren byung bas/ zhe gcig pa spre'u'i lo la sa skyar phebs/ dbyar shāka bzang sku 'bum du bzhugs nas/ khams gtsang gi grwa pa rnams la rang rang gi blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad do/

/de'i ston chos rje mnga' ris nas phebs ma thag tu/ slar yang gsung ngag rin po che zla ba bdun gyi bar du nyams khrid du zhus/ dang por bdun cu tsam gyis zhus kyang / phyis rje 'di nyid sogs bcu bzhi tsam zhig gis mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ gzhir gnas kyi rten dkyil 'khor bzhi la smin byed kyi dbang bzhi bskur zhing / grol byed kyi lam bzhi bsgom pas so so'i lta ba bzhi rgyud la skyes shing / grub mtha' bzhi dang / 'bras bu bzhi 'dren pa'i snyan brgyud bzhis gdams par mdzad de/ rgyu dus dang lam dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ nyams myong mtshan nyid pa skyes pas byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams/ gang yang ting nge 'dzin du bsel shes pas gdams ngag gi sarga ma log de'i stobs kyi bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes pas mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim par mdzad pa yin no/ /de'i chos skor la ring brgyud dang nye brgyud gnyis las/ dang po ni/ zhang dgon pa ba nas brgyud pa/ rje btsun gyi glegs bam dkar chag tu thebs pa rnams yin la/ de yang tshad ma bzhi ston pa las/ bstan bcos tshad ma la 'grel pa gnyags ma/ skabs kyi yig chung nyer gnyis/ don bsdus ma'i tshigs bcad de nyer bzhi/ nyams myong tshad ma la gzhung las 'phros pa'i chos bcu bdun/ rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bring po/ rang gi rtsa ba cung zad dang bcas pa'i lam bsdus pa/ khrid kyi gzhung shing chen po bzhi/ rtogs pa skyed par byed pa'i chos lnga/ lam zab mo'i yig cha/ man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs gzhan du kha 'phangs pa ste sum cu/ bla ma tshad ma la bla ma rgya bod kyi yi ge gnyis/ lung tshad ma la lung sbyor kha 'phangs dang bcas pa bzhi ste/ drug cu po de dag yongs su rdzogs par gsan no/ /man ngag phra mo'i rkang grangs pod dmar ma'i nang du bzhugs pa rnams dang / phyis gsan pa gzhung bshad sras don ma/ gzhan yang dmar gyis mdzad pa'i bla ma'i rnam thar zhib mo rdo rje dang /

gzhung bshad dmar ma/ bar ston gyi zin bris sogs rab tu mang po dang / bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i tshad ma dang po gsum ston pa pod nag mar grags pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par gsan te/ so so'i phyag len dang skabs kyi go ba rnams la sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa nye brgyud la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis sa chen la gnang ba dang / sa chen gyis rje btsun la gnang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni lam sbas te bshad pa/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bsrung ba gnyis la sogs pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni brda don gsal ba ste/ de dag kyang khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa rdzogs par gsan no/ /gzhan yang lam skor la/ ngag dbang grags pa'i phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa/ tog rtse ba'i bsam mi khyab/ klu sgrub kyi mchod rten drung thob/ nag po pa'i o la pa ti/ yon po bsrang ba/ pad+ma badz+ra gyi lam/ ḍom+bi pa'i lhan cig skyes grub/ in+d+ra bhū ta'i phyag rgya'i lam dang brgyad/ zhar byung la dag pa gsum gyi khrid/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu/ sgo drug chos 'brel la sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan te/ mdor na lam 'bras lam skor zhar byung gi chos rnams/ chos rje bzang po'i zhabs kyis/ rje bud+dha shrī la gsan pa'i gsan yig nang ltar bum pa gang byo'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin no/ /gsung ngag rdzogs nas e waṃ chos ldan gyi gzhi 'dzugs pa la/ chos rje'i chag phyir zhe gnyis pa sa mo bya'i lo la ngor du phebs/ de'i ston chos rje'i zhal nas/ da 'di ru sdod la bshad nyan gyis gsungs pa la/ pha rgan cig yod pa de la sngar zhabs tog cher ma 'phrod pas shi kha sngas mgo na yod pa tsam zhig dgos pas yar 'gro bar bgyi zhus nas/ mus su phebs te lo bzhi bzhugs/ glang lo la yab rgan gshegs pa'i zhe dgu'i bar du kun rig gi cho ga mdzad pas/ mnal lam du yab rgan gad g.yang zhig la 'char la khad 'dug pa la/

lag pa nas 'then nas bde sa zhig tu bzhag pa rmis gsungs so/ /de nyid kyi lo chos rje rgyal mchog pa khro phur smon lam mdzad pa'i drung du mjal du byon nas/ e waṃ chos ldan du yang byon pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas sngar bzhin zhal da gnang ba la/ da rung rus pa la sāts+tsha 'debs pa sogs kyi bya ba 'ga' zhig dgos pas yar 'gro zhus nas mus su byon nas lo gcig bzhugs so/ /mdor na sa skyar sngar lo gsum/ phyis zla ba bdun/ e waṃ chos ldan du lan brgyad phebs nas/ dam pa'i chos gsan pa'i rnam grangs rgyas par ni 'dir brjod par mi nus la/ mdor bsdus pa tsam zhig bstan pa'i go rim dang bstun nas brjod na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos skor la/ dbu ma lugs dang / sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed gnyis/ rgyal sras thogs med pas chos rje bud+dha pa la gnang ba'i blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ chos rje shar pa nas rgyud pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral rnams zhus nas/ skyes tshoms dad pa'i gzhung / bslab spyod lta ba'i gzhung / sa rgyan spyod pa'i gzhung ste bka' gdams gzhung drug du grags pa dang / mdo sil bu ba bcu bdun/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi sa bcad dang bcas pa la sogs rab tu mang po gsan no/ /rdo rje theg pa'i skor la dbang / rgyud/ man ngag rjes gnang / lung dang lnga las/ dang po dbang gi skor la/ rigs gsum spyi dbang / tshe dpag med lhag dgu/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ gzungs grwa lnga la sogs pa bya rgyud kyi dbang du ma dang / a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu la sogs pa spyod rgyud kyi dbang dang / rdo rje dbyings dkyil chog lugs/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan/ nam mkha' dri med chung ba/ gtsug dgu/ rtsa skya ba nas brgyud pa'i sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ sa lugs kyi kun rig ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga ma/ lha bcu gsum ma/ dgra nag 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma/

ro langs brgyad skor/ gsang ba 'dus pa rigs gsum la sogs pa rnal 'byor chen po thabs kyi rgyud kyi dbang du ma dang / kye rdo rje bir+wa pa'i lugs gnyis/ mtsho skyes kyi lugs/ nag po pa'i lugs te bka' babs bzhir grags pa dang / rtsa rgyud kyi bdag med ma/ gur bsdus/ saṃ bu ṭa/ rdor dbyings/ kye rdor bcu bdun ma/ sgrol ma lus dkyil/ sgrol ma bcu bdun ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ ma hā mā yā/ 'khor lo bde mchog lo nag dril gsum/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ dril bu lha lnga/ lwa ba pa'i bcu gsum ma/ mai tri bcu gsum ma/ sdom 'byung ste rnal 'byor chen po shes rab kyi rgyud kyi dbang bskur ba rnams gsan no/ /gnyis pa la bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi dang / so so'i rgyud rnams kyi don phyogs gcig tu ston pa/ bya rgyud spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa dang / spyod pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa spyod rgyud spyi'i rnam par gzhag pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pha la nas brgyud pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi man ngag gi bshad pa dang / nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i rtogs bdun gyi man ngag gi bshad pa dang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud 'grel chen sgron me gsal ba dang bcas pa'i bshad pa dang / mar pa nas brgyud pa'i ma hā mā yā'i bshad pa dang / bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa/ bla ma gong ma'i chos sna bcu gsum dang bcas pa dang / nā ro pa nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi bshad pa rnams gsan te/ thos bsam gyi mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ bka' srol gang gi lugs yin pa dang / bka' srol de'i 'chad tshul ji ltar yin pa dang / bshad tshul des bshad pas lam gyi srol ji ltar thon pa'i tshul rnams la 'khrul pa'i dri ma zad cing sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad pa zhig go /gsum pa man ngag la/ bskyed rim/ rdzogs rim/

thun mong bsgrub pa'i man ngag gsum las/ dang po la/ kye'i rdo rje/ 'khor lo bde mchog gsang ba 'dus pa/ gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa'i bskyed pa'i rim pa/ bka' srol de'i lugs thun mong ma yin pa rnams ni lugs gzhan dang ma 'dres pa rnams dang / thun mong ba sbyang gzhi sbyong ba'i tshul la sogs pa rnams nang phan tshun mi 'gal zhing / rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub thob kyis bkral ba ji lta ba dang / de la yang phyi nang gi bskyed pa'i rim pa'i khyad par dang / nang bskyed pa'i rim pa la yang / rgyud sde'i khyad par gyis zab khyad kyi rim pa ji ltar yod pa dang / de la gzhan dag gis rtogs pas brtags pa'i lugs rnams lung rigs kyis ci ltar dgag pa'i tshul rnams legs par gsan cing sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad de/ rang gis bsgoms na sa lam chod cing / gzhan la bstan na gdul bya mi bslu bar mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ gshed dmar gyi shin tu spros med/ gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rim pa lnga/ kye rdo rje sogs la brten pa'i sngar smos pa'i lam skor dgu/ 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa'i rim pa lnga/ nag po spyod pa'i rim pa bzhi pa/ rtsa dbu ma lam gyi yan lag dang bcas pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid/ bde mchog snyan brgyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor/ sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa'i rdzogs rim rnams gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes par mdzad do/ /gsum pa thun mong sgrub pa'i man ngag la/ rab rig 'dzin mkha' spyod 'khor los sgyur ba sgrub pa sogs dang / 'bring grub pa chen po brgyad/ dman pa zhi sogs kyi las rab 'byams sgrub pa'i tshul/ rgyud sde las gsungs pa brgyud pa'i man ngag las byung ba rnams dang / khyad par du dmar po skor gsum la brten nas las sgrub tshul gyi bye brag mang po dang /

rdo rje nag po chen po dang / mgon po gdong bzhi pa la brten nas las sgrub tshul gyi bye brag thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams gsan no/ /bzhi pa rjes gnang gi skor la/ rdo rje rnam 'joms dang / 'phags ma sgrol ma la sogs pa bar chad zhi ba'i lha rnams dang / don zhags lha lnga ma/ bcu gcig zhal la sogs pa byang chub kyi sems rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / sgrol ma dkar mo dang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal la sogs pa tshe rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / 'jam dpal gyi rigs rab tu mang po dang / sher phyin dkar mo mi g.yo ba dkar sngon la sogs pa blo gros rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / dzam+bha la dang / nor rgyun ma la sogs pa nor rgyas pa'i lha rnams dang / dmar po skor gsum la sogs pa 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i lha rnams dang / nag po chen po lcam dral dang / mgon po gdong bzhi pa la sogs pa bstan pa bsrung zhing drag po'i las sgrub pa'i lha rnams kyi rjes gnang rab tu mang po dang / sgrub thabs rgya mtshor grags pa rjes gnang nyis brgya dang sum cu rtsa bgrangs pa dang / sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa rjes gnang dgu bcu go drug bzhugs pa'i rjes gnang gi rigs rab tu mang po gsan no/ /gzhan yang bir+wa pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi byin rlabs dang / nā ro mkha' spyod la sogs pa mkha' spyod kyi rigs mang po'i byin rlabs dang / bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs la sogs pa byin rlabs kyi rigs mang po gsan no/ /lnga pa lung gi skor la/ rgyud 'bum gzungs 'dus/ gzungs 'bum rnams dang / de dag gi dgongs 'grel la/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi rgya gzhung 'ga' zhig dang / gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i skor 'ga' zhig dang / dmar po la bir+wa pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung drug la sogs pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung rnams dang / de'i rjes 'brang nag po pa la sogs pa'i gzhung rnams dang /

sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po/ rdzogs rim grol ba'i thig le ste gnyis dang / mar me mdzad bzang po'i dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la sogs pa 'dus pa'i rgya gzhung rnams dang / kye'i rdo rje'i bka' srol gsum la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgur grags pa rnams dang / 'khor lo bde mchog la lo hi pas mdzad pa'i dpal mngon par rtogs pa smad lnga dang bcas pa dang / dril bu skor gsum/ nag po gzhung drug la sogs pa grub chen gyi gzhung dang / rgyud kyi 'grel pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras lnga'i bka' 'bum/ chos rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum la sogs pa bod kyi legs bshad kyi lung rab tu mang po gsan no/ /de dag kyang thos bsam gtso che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ yang dag par na gong du smos pa'i khrid de dag zhus pa'i dus nyid nas bsgom pas nyams myong rgyud la skyes par mdzad cing / bar skabs su ri khrod dben pa rnams su bzhugs nas kyang nyams len la dril ba yin no/ /lnga pa la gnyis te/ spros pa bcad nas nyams len la bzhugs pa'i tshul/ nyams len ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya chen thos pas zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba'i don dben pa'i gnas su rtse gcig tu nyams su len pa ni chos nyid do/ /de yang 'di skad thos te/ zhe bdun pa shing pho stag gi lo la e waṃ chos ldan du phebs pa na/ chos rje'i zhal nas da 'di ru sdod la bshad nyan gyis/ gdan sa'i ming btags 'dod na'ang byed pas chog ber thul 'dra gon pa dang / mchod cha dang rten gsum sogs 'dod na'ang / bla brang nas long la bed gcod gyis/ bdag chen grags blo ba'i dbon po zhig yod pa 'di rab byung byed pa'i slob dpon yang 'tshol ba yin gsungs pa la/

bdag la 'di lta bu spros pa med pa'i rgyu mtshan thugs la mnga' rgyu yin/ zhe la 'dod pa yod kyang kha la 'dod pa med pa skad ston pa'i spyod pa ni ci yang med snyam nas/ de dag la 'dod bzhed med pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms par 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams rim par zhus nas/ yos lo la yar phebs par rtsom pa na/ chos rje'i drung du/ yar sleb nas lo gsum du mtshams dam pa gcig byed/ de nas kyang phal cher mtshams ka byed par zhu zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ spyir sangs rgyas sgrub pa la gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa gcig dgos/ de yang gsang sngags kyi rdzogs rim zab mo la brten nas sgrub pa'i tshul yod kyang / de 'grub par dka' bas/ thos bsam la brten nas bsgrub pa khe che/ de la yang gzhan la nyan pa bas/ rang gi cung zad shes nas 'chad par 'di shes rab skye phul che bas/ yar phyogs su don gnyer ba re re tsam byung na sna len mdzod gsungs pa thugs la bzhag nas mus su byon te/ de'i dbyar chu bzang dgon par bzhugs nas bsags sbyang gi rnal 'byor gtso bor mdzad do/ /de'i ston bzhugs nas zhe dgu pa 'brug lo tshang ma la lha gong ri khrod du rtsa sngags āṣ+ṭa'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ mjug tu shā sa na 'bum phrag bzhi dang bcas pa gdan gcig gi steng du mdzad do/ /de nas lnga bcu pa sbrul gyi lo la lung pa de'i nya dang ri dwags sogs skyobs pa dang / bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyun mi chad pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can gzigs nas/ gling kha bde ba can gyi dgon pa btab ste/ de nyid kyi lor ni gu lam 'bras la sogs pa'i zab chos btsugs/ der bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun thams cad gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i steng du/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i blo sbyong gis rgyud sbyangs nas/ gsung ngag la thugs dam mdzad de/ rab tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa dang /

'bring thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor/ tha ma thun gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la bkod par mdzad cing / bde dges gsang gsum dang kun rig gi phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun yang 'dzugs par mdzad do/ /de nas bzung ste gtso bor sgrub pa la gzhol zhing / chos rje'i gsung dang du len pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis skabs skabs su gdul bya skal ldan rnams la gsung ngag la sogs pa zab mo'i chos kyis tshim par mdzad pa'i ngang nas/ nga gnyis pa la e waṃ chos ldan du lan cig phebs/ slar nga dgu pa me pho stag gi lo la e waṃ chos ldan du phebs nas gsung ngag zhus pa'i tshe/ chos rje bzang po'i zhabs gsung ngag gi dam tshig gis bshad pa yan rdzogs nas/ yangs pa'i sa chen po la dbang bsgyur ba rin spungs pa sku mched kyis gdan drangs te/ rje 'di nyid la lam 'bras pa rnams la bdag med ma'i dbang bskur zhig gyis la lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med shod/ 'khar rnga 'di sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i chos rnga yin pas chos brda thong gsungs nas gshegs pa'i rjes su bka' bzhin bsgrub pa la zla ba gnyis bzhugs so/ /de nas dpal nā len+d+rar rong ston chos rje'i spyan sngar mjal du byon nas/ phar phyin khrid yig mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang / sgom rim tha ma'i bshad pa rnams gsan nas/ de phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen che bar grags pa/ glang thang spyan snga ba kun dga' rgya mtshan pa la sogs pas chos zhu ba'i ched du thabs kyis gdan 'dren par mdzad na yang / der ma bzhugs par mus su byon no/ /re gcig pa la chos rje bzang po'i zhabs mnga' ris su thegs pa'i rjes su/ phyag rtags dang bka' zhal la brten nas/ e waṃ chos ldan du gsung ngag la sogs pa'i zab chos du mas der bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams tshim par mdzad nas lo gcig bzhugs/ slar yang re gsum pa dang re bdun pa la e waṃ chos ldan du phebs shing / phyi ma la rgyud 'bum la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsungs so/

/de'i ston mus su phebs nas dben gnas bsam gtan phug brtsigs te/ re brgyad pa phag gi lo la sku mtshams dam par mdzad nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ pha rol du phyin pa'i nyams len mdzad tshul/ rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po la/ don dam byang chub kyi sems nyams su blang tshul ni/ dben gnas dngul chur zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ dngul chur blo sbyong zhus nas don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i tshe/ snang ba'i dngos po thams cad dngul chu'i rgya mtsho bzhin du tshugs mi thub par rnam par g.yo zhing / rtsig pa dang ri la sogs pa la thogs med du 'jug nus pa'i nyams myong rgyud la skyes par mdzad do/ /kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems nyams su blangs pa'i tshul ni/ rgyun chad med par zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi don bsgom pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems goms par mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ ri khrod dben pa rnams su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gna' ba la sogs pa'i ri dwags 'dus nas la la pang du nyal/ la las rgyab nas phul te/ bu chung ngu ba ma la btud pa bzhin mig rig rig zhal du bltas par gyur to zhes thos so/ /yang ri khrod cig tu gna' mo cig dang / gna' khyi cig mnyam du gsos pas phan tshun byams sems ldan par gyur te/ nam zhig khyi yul du khrid pa'i tshe/ gna' mos khyi la bltas nas mar la 'gro/ rje la bltas nas yar 'ong ba'i tsab tsob tu gyur to zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang snying rje chen po g.yos pa'i stobs kyi/ mtshan thog thag tu bshums pa la sogs pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir na/ re gsum pa la bu le rong du chos rje sems dpa' chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa'i drung du mjal du byon pa'i tshe/

blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid dang / blo sbyong gi rgya gzhung dang / bod gzhung gi lung rab tu mang po gnang nas/ da chos bdag po'i lag tu 'phrod pas blo bde/ khyod kyis blo sbyong 'di'i bka' ma chad pa gyis gsungs nas chos 'di'i bdag por dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mnyam gzhag gi nyams len dang / mnyam par ma gzhag pa'i nyams len no/ /dang po ni/ dbang gis mtshon pa'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad lnga ste/ dang pos lta ba/ gnyis pas phyi bskyed rim/ gsum pas nang bskyed rim/ bzhi pas rdzogs rim nyams su blang tshul dang / lnga pas bsgoms pa las byung ba'i drod rtags bstan no/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis nyams len thams cad la dbang gis mtshon pa'i lta ba brjod bral zung 'jug gis rgyas btab nas nyams su blang bar mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ srin po gdong du ri khrod mdzad pa'i tshe/ brag chen po ral nas cha ther dum bur btang zhing / mtha' rdo phung gis non pa'i nang du sku lus la cung zad tsam yang gnod pa med par bzhugs so/ /phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshe/ sgra tshul dang mngon byang la sogs pa'i bskyed chog thams cad sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba la gnad du bsnun cing / nang bskyed rim bsgom pa'i tshe/ 'khor lo lnga dang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i rtsa thig rnams la gnad du bsnun nas bsgom pas tha mal gyi snang ba ye shes lngar 'char/ rtsa rlung rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pa yin no/ /rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshe/ rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / rdo rje lus kyi 'khrul 'khor la sogs pas gzung 'dzin bskyed pa'i rlung sems dbu mar bcug nas bde stong mchog gi ye shes mngon du mdzad de/ shāka bzang sku 'bum du chos rje'i drung du 'khrul 'khor mdzad pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin la yun ring po cig song 'dug de'i stobs kyis phyis a mar rgyab pa'i tshe/

ting nge 'dzin bzang po re skye ba yin gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis lus nyams dang / sems nyams dang / gzhan sems shes pa la sogs pa'i yon tan mngon du mdzad de lha gong ri khrod du dge bshes seṅge grags pa la khams phyogs kyi rnam rtog du ma skyes pa'i nangs par/ de lta bu'i rtog pa 'og 'gyu ma byed par dge sbyor gyis gsungs pa dang / bla ma dbon po la chags pa'i rnam rtog mngon gyur du skyes pa'i tshe/ gdong la phyag mdzub btsugs nas/ sdug phrug 'di la rtog ngan rgyus byung ngas e bshad gsungs pa la/ mi gsung bar zhu zhes zhus so zhes khong rang gnyis las thos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog ces sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ dang po gnyis kyis bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ gsum pas thun mtshams kyi bya ba/ bzhi pas bza' ba dang / nyal ba dang / ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gsum bstan to/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis 'khor lo bde mchog dang / 'jam dbyangs dang / gshin rje gshed dang / ma hā kā la dang / spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i gsang sngags bye ba du ma rab tu bzlas par mdzad de/ yig drug bye ba bdun song gsungs shing / gzhan rnams la yang rgyun du thugs dam mdzad par snang ngo / /khyad par rtsa sngags āṣ+ṭa sngar 'bum phrag drug lha gong du 'bum phrag bdun bzlas pas mnal lam du yi dam gyi lung bstan par nges te/ rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur zhig gi dus su/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa tha ma ming gdags su rung tsam byung bas zhes gsungs pa dang / e waṃ chos ldan du bzhugs pa'i nub gcig gling skya'i rgyab ri de na ga ya dha ra'i bum chu yin zer ba'i chu chen po skya chil ba cig brdol byung bas/ de ma thag tu chos gos la gshog pa mdzad nas gling skya'i brag la 'phur song ba rmis gsungs pa dang / yang bde mchog gi bsnyen pa mdzad pa'i tshe/

ri ngos chen po cig bde mchog gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po cig gis khebs 'dug par smis gsungs so/ /thun mtshams kyi gnas skabs su mchod gtor la sogs pa dge ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad cing / spyod lam gyi tshe/ lhag pa'i lha'i thabs la mkhas pa dang / lha so so'i thabs la mkhas pa gang rung gis snang ba tha mal du ma lus par mdzad la/ rnal 'byor gzhan rnams kyang tshul bzhin du nyams su len par mdzad do/ /khyad par du mnal du song ba'i gnas skabs kun du/ oṃ gsum mam/ bde mchog gi sngags gang rung sgra lhang lhang dang bcas te gsung bar drung na gnas pa dag gis nges par gyur to/ /drug pa ni/ ting krol gnas su zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ g.ya' ma ting krol du ri khrod mdzad pa'i tshe/ nub gcig mnal lam du bud med smug tshon ma cig gis ston pa'i gser sku cig gtad nas sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bstan pa 'di nyams 'dug pas/ da khyod kyis 'bad pa chen po gyis la slongs shig zer ba rmis zhes thos so/ /yang rdzing lung du thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du gzigs shing / lho phug tu bla ma bzang skyong ba dang lhan cig ri khrod mdzad pa'i tshe/ tho rangs shig khong gi lung pa 'od kyis khengs pa mthong nas bltas pas/ rje 'di nyid spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi par gnas pa la/ lho rtsa'i spyan ras gzigs de 'dra ba dpag tu med pas bskor nas phyag thal mo sbyar nas btud par mthong ba dang / yang bde ba can gyi gzims khang rnying pa na bzhugs dus shig bud med las dag pa cig gis spyan ras gzigs su mthong ba'i lo rgyus kyang snang ngo / /ra lung gi brag la bzhugs pa'i dus su da lta bod na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i grwa pa mang po med/ gang yod pa 'di'i dpon po khyod kyis byed dgos zer ba cig rmis gsungs so/ /bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams mdzad pa'i dus su/

rje sa chen byon nas/ khyod kyis sngon dbang bskur thob pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di yin gsungs nas gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi dkyil 'khor yin snyam pa cig bstan/ yang chos khri chen po mang po 'dug pa su'i yin dris pas/ sa skya pa yab sras khu dbon rnams kyi yin zer/ de rnams las che ba cig 'dug pa dris pas/ khyod kyi yin zer ba rmis/ yang zhwa lu'i sa cha 'dra ba cig na chos khri chen po gnyis 'dug pa dris pas/ bu ston rin po che dang / sems dpa' chen po gnyis kyi yin zer/ de gnyis las che ba cig 'dug pa dris pas/ khyod kyi yin zer ba rmis/ yang nub gcig chos rje rin po ches mchod stegs 'dra ba zhig khra yal yal zhig gtad nas/ 'di na bza' brag phug pa'i yin/ khyod gzhan don rgyun ring ba'i rten 'brel byed pa yin zer ba rmis so/ /bdun pa la gnyis te/ rgyu rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba'i tshul/ 'bras bu phrin las mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'dren pa mchog gis zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni/ dam pa gong ma'i srol bzung nas/ rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyi mgon skyabs mdzad pa ni chos nyid do/ /de yang 'di ltar bsam gtan phug gi sku mtshams grol nas/ re dgu pa me pho byi ba'i lo la skal ldan mang po la gsung chos mang po btsugs te/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi chos skor mang po dang / lam 'bras kyiṃ snang ba gsum gyi khrid song ba'i tshe/ e waṃ chos ldan nas/ chos rje'i phyag rtags dang bcas te gdan 'dren par byung nas sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu la bteg ste/ nyi shu gsum la e waṃ chos ldan du phebs so/ /de yang chos rje'i dgongs pa la/ tshes bcu tsam la phebs sam snyam nas bya bral ba e byung ltos zhes yang yang gsungs shing / nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi bye brag mang po dang me tog gi char yang mang po byung ngo / /bcu'i nyin par yang de bzhin du byung yang /

nyi shu lnga'i bar brtan par bzhugs pa ni/ rje 'di nyid la bstan pa gtad pa'i ched du yin par nges so/ /de nas nyi shu bzhi'i nyin/ zho bco brgyad yod pa'i gser thig po cig gis mgo byas/ gser zho sum cu so bgrang zhig phul nas mjal ba'i tshe/ chos rje nyid kyi sku chos dang / rdo rje dril bu dang / rje sa chen gyi yin thad rnams gnang nas/ rjes kyi bya ba 'di ltar gyis kyi zhal da mdor bsdus dang / 'di dang mus gnyis yar 'byon mar 'byon gyis la bstan pa'i bya ba rgyun ma chad par mdzod gsungs te/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur bar mdzad do/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ rjes kyi bya ba mdzad tshul/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor tshul/ 'bras bu bstan 'dzin bskrun tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dam tshig sdom la zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ dam tshig la nyes pa'i dri ma med pa dang / bla ma la lhag pa'i lha dang dbyer med du blta ba'i phyir na/ de'i thugs dgongs rnams ji lta ba bzhin bsgrub par mdzad de/ chos rje nyid kyis zhal da'i lugs bzhin/ phyag rdzas kyi steng nas rten gsum gyi drung du mar me phreng ba la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas ched du bzhag par 'os pa rnams ni de ltar bzhag gdan sa chen po dang / gsang phu dang / nā len+d+ra la sogs pa'i chos sde chen po rnams su dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya bar 'os pa rnams ni phun sum tshogs par bsgrubs/ e waṃ chos ldan du bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la gnang byin mdzad par 'os pa rnams ni skabs su babs par bsgrubs/ gshegs rjes kyi gsol 'debs dang / lo dus kyi dus chen rnams la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi phyag len rnam par dag pa'i sgrub mchod kyi rgyun btsugs/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi dus mchod la dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur rnam par dag pa yang 'dzugs par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang sku'i rten du chos rje nyid kyi sku 'dra sku tshad ma dang /

thub pa chos 'chad ma shin tu che ba zangs gser las grub pa dang / gsung gi rten du rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras lnga/ chos rje nyid dang bcas pa'i bka' 'bum dang / thugs kyi rten du gtsang khang gi nang du/ gdung tshwa bzhugs pa'i mchod rten shin tu che ba gser gyis spras pa dang / phyi rol du bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ re re la yang gser gdugs gser tog dang bcas pa rnams lo gcig lhag tsam gyi nang du yongs su rdzogs par grub ste/ lha bzo ba thams cad kyang bsnyen bkur dang yon la sogs pas yid tshim par byas/ gzungs gzhug dang / zhabs bsdams dang / rab gnas rnams ni rgyud sde dang mthun par mdzad de/ bkra shis kyi dpal 'bar bar bzhugs pa yin no/ /sku gdung la ring bsrel byung ba rnams ni/ gser sku gnyis kyi thugs kar bzhugs shing / lhag ma gdung thal dang bcas pa rnams la sāts+tsha khri tsho bdun btab nas/ phyed bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad dang / gtsang khang gi 'bum pa'i nang du bzhugs/ phyed gser la sogs pa'i na bza' can du byas te/ phyogs phyogs su dad pa'i rten du sbyin par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdzad pa'i rim pa dang sbyar nas mdor bstan pa/ bstan pa'i rim pa dang bstun nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma mchog gi zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam dang / gnas lugs tshul bzhin du nges pa'i shes rab kyi stobs kyis dam pa'i chos ji ltar bstan pa thams cad gdul bya rnams kyi blo dang 'tsham par don du gnyer ba ni chos nyid do/ /de yang 'di ltar chos rje bzang po'i zhabs bde ba can du gshegs pa'i rjes de nas lo gnyis kyi bar du/ dbang / rgyud/ man ngag lung la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad par bskor bar mdzad cing / de nas don gcig pa sa pho stag gi lo la mus su phebs nas/ bde ldan ri khrod kyi dgon pa btab/

der yang gsung ngag la sogs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor nas/ slar yang de'i ston e waṃ chos ldan du phebs te/ sngar bzhin du gdams pa zab mos gdul bya rnams tshim par mdzad/ de'i tshe stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rin spungs pa sku mched kyis gdan drangs nas/ chos zab mo zhus te/ de'i ston yang mus su phebs nas/ don gsum pa 'brug gi lo la bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams shin tu dam par mdzad/ sbrul lo shar ma thag tu bde ldan ri khrod du gsung ngag la sogs pa'i gdams pa zab mo rnams btsugs nas chos 'phro rnams rdzogs pa'i tshe/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po'i sprul pa ta'i si tu rnam rgyal grags pa dpal bzang po yab sras dang / ngam rings chos sde'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyis 'bad pa chen pos gdan drangs te/ chos sder phebs nas/ bdag po yab sras la dbang bskur rnam par dag pa dang / chos sde'i dge bshes rnams la gsung ngag la sogs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi char chen po phab ste/ rnam grol gyi lo thog ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa dang / skyes pa spel bar mdzad pa yin no/ /slar yang de'i ston e waṃ chos ldan du phebs nas/ phyogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen stong phrag tsam 'dus pa la/ gsung ngag la sogs pa'i gdams pa zab mo bstan/ yo byad kyi dngos po phyag tu byung ba rnams la/ la la ni gser gyi gan ji ra bsgrubs te/ gtsug lag khang gi steng du btsugs/ 'ga' zhig ni gtsug lag khang du mchod rdzas kyi rgyu ru bzhag gzhan dag ni/ che 'go rnams la gnang sbyin dang / dge 'dun spyi la bsnyen bkur mdzad/ don lnga pa rta lo'i dpyid mus su phebs nas/ bde ldan ri khrod du dad ldan rnams la gdams pa zab mos tshim par mdzad/ de'i dgun so slar yang byang pa yon mchod rnams kyis gdan drangs nas dpal ngam rings su phebs te/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/

slar yang bde ldan ri khrod du lug gi lo'i dbyar gsung ngag la sogs pa'i gdams pa zab mo gnang nas/ de'i dgun so gle lung chos sder chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po skor bar mdzad cing / don bdun pa spre'u lo'i dbyar zla ba lnga pa dang drug pa rnams la mtshan ma bzlog pa'i ched du thugs dam zab mo mdzad cing / slar yang bdag chen bzhi thog pa la sogs pa'i dam pa rnams la chos kyi char gyis tshim par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa la/ so thar/ byang sems/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi bstan pa spel ba'i tshul gsum las/ dang po ni/ legs gsungs 'dul ba'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa don du gnyer ba rnams blo'i rim pa dang 'tsham par/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong gi sdom pa la/ dri ma med pa'i cho gas bkod par mdzad de/ sngar chos rje bzang po'i zhabs zhal bzhugs pa na/ rje 'di nyid dang gdan 'dzom pa'i tshe/ chos rje ngor pa dang / chos rje mus pa lta bu'i mkhan slob 'dzom pa'i dus su bsnyen rdzogs la 'gro zer nas/ phyogs mtha' dag nas sprin bzhin du 'dus pa dang / phyis rang nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad pa'i sgo nas rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs mdzad pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ a ti sha'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ chos rje rgyal mchog pas khyod kyis blo sbyong 'di'i bka' ma chad par gyis gsungs pa la brten nas/ dbyar dgun rnams su blo sbyong re ma chag par gsungs shing / don du gnyer ba nam byung dus su gsungs par mdzad pas/ bka' srol 'di'i yang bdag por gyur cing / theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len rgyas par mdzad pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ thun mong lam gyi zhes sogs tshigs bcad drug ste/ dang pos dbang bskur ba/ gnyis pas rgyud bshad pa/ de nas gsum gyis man ngag gnang ba/ tha mas lung gi sgo nas bstan pa spel ba bstan to/ /de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis dbang bskur ba'i tshe na yang /

rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang / slob ma lhar bskyed pa rnams gdan gsum tshang bar dag bya dag byed ngo sprad nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i cho ga rnam par dag pas dbang bskur bas sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs par mdzad pa zhig go /rgyud 'chad pa'i tshe mtha' drug tshul bzhi la sogs pa 'chad tshul rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas zab don gyi nor bu ston par mdzad pa zhig go /man ngag gnang ba'i tshe bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag zab mo rnams la rtog ges brtags pa'i grub mtha' rnams lung rigs kyis bkag nas rgyud sde'i dgongs pa man ngag bzhin ston par mdzad pa zhig go /khyad par du snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas gangs ri'i khrod kyi don gnyer rnams rnam grol gyi lam la bkod par mdzad de/ sngar phan chad gsung ngag tshar nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gsung bar mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rgyud 'bum dang / 'dul ba lung dang dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chen po rnams dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i bka' 'bum gyi lung rnams kyis kyang dri ma med pa'i bstan pa spel bar mdzad do/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar dri med ces sogs tshigs bcad gnyis te/ sngar bshad pa de ltar rang don mkhyen pa dang thugs rje phul du byung zhing / gzhan don phrin las rmad du byung ba mdzad pa'i stobs kyis gangs ri'i khrod kyi che bar grags pa mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul bdag chen bzhi thog pa kun dga' dbang phyug legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug legs pa'i 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen bzhi thog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen shar pa ye shes dbang phyug rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan rnams kyis kyang zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs shing gdams pa zab mo nos te spyi bo'i cod paṇa du khur bar mdzad do/

/gzhan yang lung rigs la dbang bsgyur ba'i mkhas pa chen po byams chen mkhan po bsod nams chos kyi kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ glang thang spyan mnga' ba kun dga' rdo rje sku mched/ dro pa mkhan po chos kyi spyan ldan shes rab bzang po/ ngam rings mkhan po kun dga' grub dang / mkhas pa sangs rgyas seng ge mkhas pa'i dbang po don yod dpal bzang po/ bstan pa'i rtsa lag kun mkhyen sangs rgyas 'phel/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' bsod nams la sogs pa gangs ri'i khrod kyi mkhas pa dag gis khyod kyi gsung thub pa'i gsung ltar gus pas bsten cing phyogs bcur spel bar mdzad do/ /brgyad pa ni/ ris bsgyur phyogs ni zhes sogs tshigs bcad gsum ste/ don bdun pa shing pho spre'u'i lo tha skar zla ba'i nyi shu gsum nas/ dgu'i bar du sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas te/ dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu bdud rtsi'i ril bu tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa bar chad med par mthar phyin te/ dri bzang po dang me tog gi char la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po yang byung ngo / /slar yang dben gnas de nyid du sku mtshams dam par bcad nas rim gnyis zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs te/ shing mo bya'i lo cho 'phrul chen po'i tshes bco lnga la/ bla ma nam mkha' dpal bzang sku mdun du mjal ba'i tshe/ na ning nas rje sa chen dang mjal ba la dpe med du byed na/ da lo ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug yang mnal lam du byung gsungs pas/ khong gi zhabs la 'jus te/ chos rje rin po che la de lta bu los 'ong zhus zer ba thos so/ /gzhan yang 'di'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mkhas grub gzhon nu seng ge pas sa chen gyi dngos slob/ gnyan phul byung ba'i skye ba yin pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba dang / sgom sde phra ral la chos rje bzang po'i zhabs kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba gnang ba rje 'di nyid kyis gsol ba'i rmi lam byung ba dang /

grub thob chen pos khyod kha rag sgom chung gi skye ba yin no zhes gsungs pa yang thos so/ /gzhan yang zab don 'chad pa'i tshe blos brtags kyi grub mtha' rnams lung rigs nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis bsal nas/ zab don gyi pad tshal 'byed pa 'di lta bu ni dus mnyam pa'i mkhas pa sus kyang 'gran par mi bzod do/ /phas rgol dang rtsod pa'i tshe/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa gnam lcags kyi thog babs nas log rtog gi brag ri bsnyil ba ni/ 'phags yul gyi phyogs glang chos grags dang tshul mtshungs te/ nyid kyi bla ma rong ston chen po dang / sems dpa' chen po gnyis kyis kyang rigs pa'i dbang phyug chen por bsngags shing / rab byung gis dbang gsum pa'i lam bsgom du mi rung ba dang / mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes la lhag mthong med par 'dod pa la btang ba'i rigs pa rnams ni/ mkhas rlom gzhan su la yang ma mthong ngo / /legs bshad rtsom pa'i tshe rna bar snyan cing 'brel chags la/ mkhas pa dag gis mthong na sngon med pa'i rtogs pa bskyed pa ni/ rje nyid kyi bka' 'bum mthong bas bsal lo/ /chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa ni/ kun la grags shing khyad par du/ sa skya 'khon gyi gdung brgyud la sogs pa che dgu dag gis chos zhus pas/ sku tshe la mi gzan nam zhus pas/ de la dga' tshor med pas skyon med gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /yo byad kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba ni/ yod byad phyag du byung ba thams cad la yang na bla ma la 'bul ba/ yang na bla ma'i dus mchod/ yang na rten gsum bzhengs pa/ yang na dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur mdzad pa las/ rang don du til 'bru tsam yang mi 'chang ba mngon sum du gyur pa 'di nyid do/ /rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab ste/ dgung lo don brgyad bzhes pa na yang / e waṃ chos ldan dang / ngam rings dang / mnga' ris gsum nas gdan 'dren pa cig car du byung ste/ thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bdag cag rnams kyi sa phyogs zhabs kyis bcags nas/

zhal bstan pa tsam zhig mdzad na yang / 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don du 'gyur ba yod do zhes zhus so/ /de'i tshe rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po kun dga' dbang phyug pa/ chos rje bzang po'i zhabs kyi bka' bzhin du/ e waṃ chos ldan gyi gdan sar bskos te/ bshad sgrub rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa bsod nams spel ba'i phyir/ rgyun bshags bya ba la bdun las/ phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ srid na khyod 'dra'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ dang po gnyis kyis dkon mchog gi sgra don/ rgyud bla ma las drug gsungs pa dang sbyar/ gsum pas rgyal gyi sgra don yab yum sras gsum dang sbyar/ bzhi pas mtshan gyis sgra don sku gsung thugs dang sbyar ba'o/ /yan lag lhag ma drug ni/ zhing 'dir dkon pa'i zhes sogs tshigs bcad drug ste/ re re yang rje nyid kyi mtshan dang spel ba'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu 'grub pa'i ched du smon lam gdab pa ni/ deng nas gzung ste zhes sogs tshigs bcad bzhi ste/ dang pos gdams pa'i rgyu/ gnyis pas gdams pa dngos la pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len/ gsum pas rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len/ bzhi pas de dag gi 'bras bu 'grub par smon pa rtsom pa po'i ming dang sbyar ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rje btsun bla ma zhes sogs tshigs bcad drug ste/ phyis drug bsnan pa ni/ dben gnas dngul chur zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / ting krol gnas su zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis dang / ris bsgyur phyogs ni zhes sogs gsum ste shin tu dag cing yid ches pa'i gnas su gyur te/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa'i yid mtshor khyab par byas pa yin no/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i yon tan cha tsam rnam par bshad pa las byung ba'i/ /bsod nams seng ges bsod nams ji snyed bsags pa de yis lus can kun/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i sdug bsngal kun nas brgal te bde ba dam pa'i gling / /rnam mang 'gro la rnam mang phan pa bsgrub pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni rje de nyid kyi slob ma dad pa brtan po dang ldan pa dag gis bskul nas/ rje de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa dge slong bsod nams seng ges shing mo bya'i lo snron gyi zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad la gling kha bde ba can du sbyar ba'o// ༈ //rnam par thar pa'i kha skong bzhugs// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ra we/ rje btsun dam pa dkon mchog rgya mtshan dpal bzang po dgung lo bdun cu don brgyad bzhes pa yan chad kyi rnam par thar pa rags rim sngar bstan zin pa de'i kha skong gi tshul du tshigs su bcad pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa cig sbyar zin pa'i don 'grel 'dir brjod par bya'o/ /de yang sngar lha sar byon pa'i dus su dgung lo bdun cu thub pa'i mtshan ma byung gsungs pa dang / de rjes lan cig bdun cu don lnga thub pa'i mtshan ma byung gsungs pa dang / bla ma nam chos pa bde bar gshegs pa'i nub mo'i mnal lam dang bstun na/ bdun cu don bdun pa'i steng du bde ba can du gshegs rgyur snang na yang / brgyad cu gya gnyis sam/ 'dul ba pa'i lugs kyi gya gsum gyi bar du bzhugs pa ni grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyi man ngag bdud rtsi lta bu snyigs dus su mi nyams pa'i ched du sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs par snang ste/ dgung lo don gsum bzhes pa 'brug lo'i nang du dben gnas bsam gtan phug tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mnal lam du/ chos rje kun dga' bzang po'i zhal nas/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags gsungs nas 'di'i sngags 'bru'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i lo grangs thub ces pa'i lung bstan brnyes par mdzad pa las shes so/ /de nas don brgyad bzhes pa bya lo'i dbyar gling kha bde ba can du/ chos rje sku skye ba la sogs pa'i skal ldan 'ga' la gsung ngag dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang po gnang nas de'i dgun so ngam rings su phebs te/

dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyis stong lhag pa la theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong la sogs pa'i gdams pa du ma gnang / de'i nang nas zab mo'i lam gyi skal ba dang ldan pa dgu brgya lhag pa la gsung ngag rin po che cha lag dang bcas pas smin par mdzad nas khyi lo sa ga zla ba'i nang du mus su phebs/ de nas bzung ste bde bar ma gshegs kyi bar bde ba can dang / bde ldan ri khrod dang / gle lung rnams su bzhugs nas/ bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug pa dang / sras kyi thu bo gung ru shes rab bzang po la sogs pa/ stod mnga' ris/ smad mdo khams/ bar dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun dad ldan dpag du med pa tshogs pa rnams la dbang / rgyud/ man ngag lung la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par smin grol la bkod par mdzad de/ glang lo'i dpyid zhing 'di'i gzhan don rdzogs pas thugs rangs te/ zhing gzhan du gshegs par bzhed nas/ gsung ngag rdzogs pa'i rjes su 'di la lam 'bras kyi rjes ma gyis gsungs/ de'i dbyar kha nas sku mtshams la bzhugs par bzhed na yang / chos rje glang thang pa phebs pas slar yang gsung ngag tshar gcig gnang bar mdzad do/ /gsung ngag ma rdzogs pa'i gong tsam du bzhi sde mkhan chen pas gtso mdzad pa rnams la nag po rim bzhi gnang ste/ chos 'phro rnams rdzogs nas zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu la chos rje glang thang pa dpon slob rnams ngor du thegs/ de rjes bdag chen blo gros dbang phyug pa bzhugs par bzhed nas zhu ba nan gyis phul ba la/ rje'i zhal nas nged da lo lung phug ya gi de nar 'chi ru 'gro ba yin/ nga shi ba'i rjes su grwa bu slob kyi 'du 'tshogs dang mchod bsngo la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi brda chad mang po dang / de dag gi mgo ma la slob ma'i drag shos sa skya 'khon gyi gdung brgyud bzhugs zhes pa'i gtam 'di la zhe 'dod dang po nas med pa yin pas cis kyang byon mdzod ces pa'i zhal ta nan gyis gnang bas/

bdag chen pas kyang bla ma'i thugs dgongs dang bstun par mdzad de nyi shu drug la bteg par mdzad do/ /de nas smin drug zla ba snga ma'i tshes gsum gyi bar zhag bdun la/ la stod lho byang sogs nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs sogs don du gnyer ba mang du byung ba rnams la sku gzugs kyis gang lcogs mdzad nas/ tshes gsum gyi nyin bsam gtan phug la bteg ste dben gnas su phebs nas/ ja sbyor cig gi ring la zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams la zhal da mang du gnang nas/ dang po nas kyi bsam pa la/ mi med kyi lung stong zhig tu 'chi sa byed dgos snyam pa yod pa de 'grub byung / da lta shi yang sems la 'phreng ba gcig kyang med/ sngar byas pa'i las la 'gyod pa yang med/ 'di bya dgos snyam pa ma grub pa yang med/ mi yul du sdod yun yang ring po yin/ gzhan la 'di bya 'di gyis kyi bkod pa yang pho lo brgyad cu gya gsum pa zhig gis mi 'ong gsungs nas thugs spros pa bcad par mdzad/ nga'i gan du dkon bzang gcig pu sdod/ gzhan su yang ma sdod gsungs pa la khong rnams kyis gung thun ran 'dug pas thog mar gung thun cig mdzad nas de rjes gsol ja zhig mdzad dam zhus pas yud pa cig khyom tsho gyis de nas khyed rang thams cad song / da nyin mtshan khor yug tu dge sbyor du 'gro ba cig byed pa ma gtogs pa thun gyis nges pa mi 'ong gsungs/ de nas bzung ste zla ba de'i nang du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ tshes brgyad kyi bar du zhabs bskor sogs kyang mang du mdzad/ de nas sku shed cung zad chung du song nas gling khar sku rim nyi ma gsum tsam bsgrubs te/ sngar sku rim yang 'di 'dra bsgrub yod/ da dung sku rim 'dra sgrub/ lha rje cig la yang bstan na drag gam zhus 'dug pas/ rim gro byas pa khyed rang rnams la phan pas byas pas 'ong / nga la ni dbus gtsang gi btsun pa thams cad 'dus nas rim gro byas/

sman pa thams cad 'dus nas sman byas kyang / da lo sdod pa med gsungs nas ma gnang / ltas ci 'dra byung zhus pas khar sing dbyar kha nas gling kha'i ri 'di rtag tu smugs pa'i rang bzhin du 'char ba cig byung / de sa chu la thim pa'i rtags yin gsungs par 'dug zla ba de'i mjug tu zhag bdun tsam cig skom dad che nas gsol ja mang du bzhes dgos pa cig byung ba de chu me la thim pa'i rtags yin gsungs zhing / rtags phyi ma gnyis la 'di yin mi gsungs/ de nas smin drug zla ba rting ma'i tshes gnyis kyi nub mo/ nyi ma brgal tsam gyi gong nas sku chos dang / sku sham phud nas bzhag pas/ de'i nub mo mnal lam du nam mkhar sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs 'dug pa cung zad mi dgyes pa'i rnam pa can du 'dug mdang dgong chos gos dang sham thabs bzhag sngas pas lan pa 'dra gsungs/ de nas mkhan chen kun blo ba sku mdun du sdod pas chog pa'i zhu ba nan gyis phul bas gnang nas tshes bzhi'i nyin par mjal ba'i tshe/ de'i nyin sku khams bde nas zhal da mang du gnang / nged la bla ma du ma yod pa'i nang nas chos rje rin po che kun dga' bzang po pa de shin tu sku drin che ba cig byung / de'i rgyu mtshan bod du rdo rje theg pa'i lam srol la bla ma gong ma nas brgyud pa'i lam srol 'di dang / mar pa nas brgyud pa'i rngog gzhung gi bka' srol dang / shangs pa nas brgyud pa'i ni gu sogs kyi bka' srol dang / bu ston rin po che nas brgyud pa'i yo ga'i bka' srol sogs mang du yod kyang / dus phyis chos rje ri bo dge ldan pas/ gsang sngags kyi bka' srol la grub mtha' gsar pa rkang btsugs nas bshad nyan gyis gtan la phabs par mdzad/ de sngar gyi bka' srol de dag gang dang yang mi mthun pa 'dug kyang / dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal cher de la dad pa cig byung / de la chos rje rin po ches grub mtha' snga phyi'i gnad gzigs nas dgag sgrub mang du mdzad/

bla ma gong ma'i bka' srol gyi rkang btsugs te de'i rjes su zhugs pas chog pa cig byung ba yin/ lam 'di nged rang gi rtsol bas byung na tshe gcig lus gcig la mchog gi dngos grub sgrub nus pa'i lam du 'dug nged rang gi slob ma rnams kyis kyang bshad nyan la sogs pa'i rtsol bas bka' srol 'di spel ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa 'dug bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab 'di'i steng du rtogs pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig nga la yod pa yin/ bstan pa'i rgyun la phan du re nas bskyed rim gyi grub mtha'i shan 'byed 'di yang brtsams pa yin/ nged rang yang chos rje rin po che'i dus tha ma'i bka' lung dang du blangs nas bshad nyan byas pas sa skya pa'i bstan pa la phan po byung / bshad nyan ma dgos par nged rang 'dod pa ltar gyi sgrub pa zhig byed rgyu byung na lus 'di ma spangs par 'gro dbang yod pa yin/ gang ltar yang thog ma med pa nas lus ji snyed cig blangs kyang da lan gyi lus 'di las don che ba ma byung 'dug gsungs pa sogs kyi thugs rangs pa'i zhal da mang du gnang / drung na gnas pa rnams kyis da lo nag po rim bzhi la mi mang ba dang / rab byung bsnyen rdzogs la sogs mang bas lan nam zhes lkog tu glengs 'dug pas de ma thag gsan nas/ de dag gang gis kyang ma lan/ da lo mi sdod par shes nas bstan pa'i rgyun la phan du re ste gang lcogs byas pa yin gsung bar 'dug go /de nas tshes brgyad kyi bar zhal da gzhan cher mi gnang bar/ res spyan nam mkha' la cer te gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad/ res phyag dang zhabs bshud cing sprug pa 'khrul 'khor gyi rnam pa mdzad/ res sku lus gar stabs kyi rnam pa mdzad pa sogs nyin mtshan khor yug tu nyams kyi ngang la bzhugs/ tshes brgyad kyi dgongs mo nyi ma rgas tsam na/ sku lus gnad bsrang / spyan bar snang la gzigs/ phyi rol gyi spros pa bcad nas ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig la bzhugs/

de yang bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul ma bstan pa'i zhag bzhi tsam gyi gong nas sku lus byis pa lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can/ spyan dkar nag 'byes shing spyan 'bras gnag pa/ snyan dang / shangs dang / mchu sgros rnams shin tu dod pa/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gnyer ma med cing / dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa cig byung 'dug pa de/ tshes brgyad nas nyi shu lnga'i bar du yang / sku mdangs de kho na'i ngang du bzhugs/ de'i stobs kyis drung na gnas pa rnams kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i snang ba ma byung zhing / bya dang / ri dwags la sogs pa rnams kyang gnas gzhan du mi 'gro bar nye 'khor de nyid du gnas pa dang / sngar med pa'i dri bzang po khyad par can gyis gzims khang gi nang rgyun du khengs pa byung 'dug go /de nas nyi shu lnga'i nyin dbu phrag pa g.yon phyogs su cung zad yo/ zhal mdangs glo bur ba de yal nas sngar gyi sku bgres pa'i zhal gdangs tsam du song / gnam gang gi bar bzhag kyang khyad gzhan ma byung nas/ na bza' g.yengs pa'i tshe lus gnad zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung la/ pus mo gnyis g.yon phyogs su cung zad bsnol/ rting pa gnyis kyi steng du 'phongs kyi snag po che bzhag phyag g.yas pa rdo rje'i khu tshur gyis mchan khung g.yon nas 'khyud/ g.yon pa sdigs mdzub dang bcas te/ de'i steng nas dpung pa g.yas la 'khyud/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrang ba/ rgya gar gyi grub chen a wa dhū tī'i bzhugs stangs su 'dug zer/ rnam par thar pa 'di las dpags na/ thugs bzhed bzhin sgrub pa mdzad pa byung na sku lus ma spangs par mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par zhal gyi bzhes 'dug cing / 'on kyang thog ma med pa nas lus ji snyed cig blangs kyang / da lan gyi lus 'di las don che ba ma byung zhes gsungs pa'i shugs kyis bar dor phyag chen mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa gdon mi za bar snang ngo / /bde bar gshegs khar sku lus la mtshan dpe cha mthun byung ba 'di ni/

chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bde bar gshegs khar ling chu rtser tho rangs shig dbus su rje btsun chen po/ g.yas su bir+wa pa/ g.yon du nag po pa byon pa gzigs te/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas skye ba gsum pa la de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar lung bstan/ bir+wa pa dang nag po pa gnyis kyis mthun 'gyur mdzad/ bir+wa pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi la srin lag gis reg par mdzad de/ khyed kyi ljags rkyongs gsungs nas ljags la thig le byas pa'i snang ba byung bas/ de'i tshe rtog pa dang rtog med kyi mtha' las 'das pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rgyud la yang / 'di las lhag pa med snyam pa 'khrungs/ de'i tshe gsang ba'i gnas sbubs su nub pa dang / dbu'i gtsug tor blta bar mi mngon pa sogs mtshan dpe rnams brnyes gsungs pa dang mthun par 'dug go/ ༈ //lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dang bcas pa/ /don yod rnam bzhis bla ma mnyes byas nas/ /ci mdzad rgyal ba'i mdzad par legs rtogs nas/ /rmad byung phrin las bsgrub la brtson par shog/ //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 36 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ rje mus pa chen po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 35
